summary: BP p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K announcing routine board committee membership changes effective August 1, 2026. Ian Tyler becomes chair of the nomination and governance committee; Tushar Morzaria becomes interim chair of the people and remuneration committee; Hina Nagarajan joins as a member. The audit, safety, and sustainability committee memberships are also listed. No strategic transaction, M&A activity, or special-situation event is involved. This is an ordinary governance disclosure required under UK Listing Rules, mapped to its US equivalent of a routine current report. No financial terms or deal mechanics apply. No further action or risk-arb angle is relevant.
